changes: Added a Koala-owned Codex adapter manifest, generated it from koala init, hardened bin/koala-codex.js and bootstrap-runner activity tagging, and updated README/.Codex guidance plus verification scripts for wrapper and fallback heartbeat behavior.
usage: Preferred Codex entrypoint is node bin/koala-codex.js session_brief. If only global koala exists, use KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1 koala session_brief.
expectedOutcome: Codex users can see and use a Koala adapter manifest and wrapper without expecting unsupported .Codex/hooks or .Codex/settings.json runtime behavior.
actualTranscript: node bin/koala-codex.js session_brief returned # koala session brief; .Codex/koala.json reports adapterOwner=koala, adapterKind=codex, activitySource=codex, local wrapper first, read-only global fallback, and excluded .Codex/hooks/.Codex/settings.json; filesystem check confirms those fake runtime assets are absent.
outcomeDiff: No product-visible mismatch; expected adapter boundary and actual outputs match.
limitations: No fake Codex runtime hooks/settings are introduced; global fallback only records read-only heartbeat when KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1 is included as documented.
pitfalls: Review found that documenting KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex alone was not enough for read-only session_brief heartbeat; fallback docs, manifest, and tests now include KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1.
